question: Can a single token-based transformer trained from scratch on interleaved text and image tokens (early fusion) be trained stably at scale and both understand and generate mixed text-image documents?
hypothesis: Quantising images into discrete tokens and training one uniform transformer end to end on all modalities gives strong unimodal and multimodal performance without modality-specific encoders or decoders.
contributions: A family of early-fusion token-based mixed-modal models that reason over and generate interleaved image-text documents.
Architectural innovations and training techniques for stable, scalable training of early-fusion token-based models.
State-of-the-art results on vision-language benchmarks while staying competitive on text-only tasks, plus image generation, in one model.
The first large-scale human evaluation on open-ended mixed-modal reasoning and generation.

method.summary: Chameleon-7B and 34B are Llama-2-style decoder transformers trained from scratch on text, code and images, where images are quantised by a VQ tokenizer into 1024 tokens from an 8192 codebook and share one 65,536-token BPE vocabulary. Stability needed QK-norm, z-loss, dropout (7B) and Swin-style norm reordering (34B). Pre-training is followed by light SFT, then human pairwise and absolute evaluation against Gemini Pro and GPT-4V plus text and image-to-text benchmarks.
method.task: mixed-modal next-token pretraining, SFT alignment, mixed-modal generation, captioning, VQA

datasets.name: Text-image pairs
datasets.preprocessing: resized and center cropped to 512x512; 50% of the time image precedes text

datasets.name: Text/image interleaved
datasets.source: public web sources, no Meta product data, similar to OBELICS

datasets.name: Second-stage mix

datasets.source: higher quality datasets plus filtered train sets of instruction tuning collections

datasets.name: Chameleon-SFT
datasets.size: Text 1.6M samples/940.0M tokens; Code 14.1K/1.1M; Visual Chat 15.6K/19.4M tokens/16.7K images; Image Generation 64.3K/68.0M/64.3K images; Interleaved 16.9K/35.8M/30.7K images; Safety 95.3K/38.6M/1.6K images
datasets.source: Text SFT from Llama-2, Code SFT from CodeLlama, vendor-collected chat and interleaved data, aesthetic-filtered licensed images, safety prompts (Rainbow Teaming, Pick-A-Pic, LLaMa-2-Chat)
datasets.preprocessing: image generation: aesthetic classifier score >=6, top 64K closest to 512x512; prompt images resized with border padding, answer images center-cropped

datasets.name: Human eval prompt set
datasets.source: third-party crowdsourcing vendor; filtered by 3-annotator majority vote

datasets.name: PIQA, SIQA, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, ARC-E, ARC-C, OBQA, BoolQ, GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, MS-COCO (Karpathy test), Flickr30k (Karpathy test), VQA-v2 test-dev

models.name: Chameleon-7B
models.architecture: Llama-2-style decoder transformer, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE, QK-norm, no GQA

models.name: Chameleon-34B
models.architecture: as 7B plus GQA and Swin-style norm reordering (h = x + attention_norm(attention(x)); output = h + ffn_norm(feed_forward(h))), no dropout

models.name: Image tokenizer
models.architecture: based on Gafni et al. (2022); encodes 512x512 image into 1024 tokens, codebook 8192

other.training data: licensed images only; faces up-sampled 2x in pre-training

models.name: Llama-2, Mistral 7B, Mixtral 8x7B, Flamingo-80B, IDEFICS-80B, Llava-1.5

training.objective: autoregressive next-token prediction over mixed-modal token sequences, plus z-loss; SFT masks loss on prompt tokens
training.lr_schedule: linear warm-up then exponential decay to 0; SFT cosine
training.precision: inferred: bf16, from the text on leaving bf16's effective range
training.regularisation: z-loss 1e-5 log2 Z; global gradient clipping 1.0; QK-norm
training.hardware: NVIDIA A100 80GB; pretraining on Meta RSC (InfiniBand), alignment on other internal clusters (Elastic Fabric)
training.compute: 7B: 1024 concurrent GPUs, 856481 GPU hours; 34B: 3072 concurrent GPUs, 4282407 GPU hours

other.SFT packing: prompts and answers packed with a delimiter token

inference.decoding: not stated for generation; benchmark scoring by highest-scoring candidate; GSM8K/MATH maj@N sampling (greedy for N=1)
inference.prompting: 0-shot commonsense; 8-shot GSM8K; 4-shot MATH; 2-shot captioning/VQA with published prompts of other models

other.inference stack: standalone PyTorch pipeline with xformers kernels, token masking for modality-constrained generation, streaming

metrics.name: Win rate
metrics.definition: 1 point per win and 0.5 per tie, over 1,048 prompts, 3 annotators majority vote

metrics.name: Task fulfillment
metrics.definition: annotators label fulfills / partially fulfills / does not fulfill

metrics.name: Accuracy
metrics.definition: benchmark accuracy; maj@N exact match for GSM8K/MATH

eval.protocol: Human pairwise and absolute evaluation by a third-party vendor, three annotators per question, responses in random order; Krippendorff's alpha 0.338 [0.319, 0.356] for task fulfillment. Chameleon-34B vs APIs. No seeds or significance tests for benchmarks.

prompts.text: If the question requires an image to be generated, then generate an image caption instead and enclose the caption in a pair of ⟨caption⟩⟨/caption⟩tags.

limits: Image tokenizer reconstructs images with much text poorly, upper-bounding OCR-heavy tasks.

Human eval prompts are crowdsourced rather than from real users, exclude OCR and infographic tasks, and baselines are API text-only models augmented with DALL-E 3 images, not native mixed-modal models.
Inter-annotator agreement is low (Krippendorff's alpha 0.338 for task fulfillment); about 10% of pairs have no agreement.
Safety tuning is SFT only; RLHF/RLAIF not applied; red team found 1.6% unsafe and 4.5% unsure.
Stability recipe found empirically; instabilities appeared late and above 8B params and 1T tokens.
Code, weights and data availability are not stated in the paper; no seeds or error bars on benchmarks; no image-generation quantitative metric (FID etc.) is reported, only human eval and samples.
Layer count, hidden size and head count are not stated.
